messages:
Rae: quick heads-up  I'm drafting a small 'terminology & snippets' playbook for docs PRs. Aim: tiny checklist + example patterns so reviewers are fast.
Diego: good call. can we force a tiny canonical glossary file and link to it from doc headers?
Priya: yes. suggest /docs/reference/glossary.md as the single source.
Zoe: for snippets: keep them runnable and language-idiomatic. JS = camelCase, Python = snake_case. show the minimal request and expected response.
Rae: agreed. i'll add a one-liner smoke test for each snippet (e.g., python -m examples.quickstart).
Diego: Naming: prefer 'model variant' for optimized builds (quantized/tuned), 'model' for architecture/topology. add short examples of correct usage.
Priya: also recommend first-use expansion: e.g., 'Dedicated capacity ("Dedicated")' then short form thereafter.
Zoe: PR labels idea: docs/term, docs/snippet, docs/migrate. keeps triage clear.
CI Bot: sample GH action to label PRs touching docs:```yaml
name: label-docs
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/labeler@v2
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
Rae: perfect. can Lint Bot add a basic check for ambiguous terms (regex list) in CI? low noise threshold.
Lint Bot: We can add a docs-lint rule that flags matches against an initial term list. will prototype.
Diego: migration checklist: update glossary, migrate snippets, add redirects or link fixes, add a short changelog entry.
Priya: include tiny do/don't examples for voice: do be concise and technical; don't be promotional or vague.
Zoe: volunteers to write the snippet examples if someone else drafts the glossary file.
Rae: i'm drafting glossary tonight. Zoe, can you do snippets? Diego, you take GH Action. Priya will write the do/don't.
Zoe: on it.
Diego: will add GH Action sample and labeler config.
Priya: will write voice guidance.
Rae: thanks all. i'll open a PR and ping reviewers. Expect a linked checklist and sample snippets.
